senses.gloss: m. (חֲשַׁךְ II) lean, poor; luckless (interch. with: חֲשׁוֹךְ, חֲשׁוֹכָא).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 18:12">Targ. Ez. XVIII, 12</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 13:4">Targ. II Sam. XIII, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 72:13">Targ. Ps. LXXII, 13</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:31">Lam. R. to I, 5</cite> <he>ולמה ח׳ כן</he> and why is he so reduced?—

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:20">Ib. to III, 20</cite> (prov.) <he>עד דשמינא חשיך חשיכא מיית</he> Ar. (Var <he>כחיש כחישא</he>; ed. … <he>קטין … דקטינא …</he>) while the fat one becomes lean, the lean one is dead (retribution to the oppressor comes too late).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 22:16">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII, 7</cite>, v. <cite ref="H00648"><he>חַי</he></cite> ch.—Pl. <he>חֲשִׁיכַיָּא</he>, <he>חֲשׁוּכַּ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 52:15">Targ. Jer. LII, 15</cite>, sq.—
Succ. 44ᵇ לחשוכיא (Ms. M. 2 לחסיניא, read לחֲסִיכַ׳) to the poor.—Fem. חֲשִׁיכָא, חֲשִׁיכְתָּא.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 54:11">Targ. Is. LIV, 11</cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="H01838"><he>חֲשִׁיכַן</he></cite>, <cite ref="H01839"><he>חֲשִׁיכָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 41:19">Targ. Y. Gen. XLI, 19</cite>, sq; v. <cite ref="H01374"><he>חֲסִיךְ</he></cite>.
